cohort: Women who underwent cesarean section (CS) at Minia Maternity University Hospital, Egypt between January 2013 and December 2017
finding: The study found an SSI incidence of 5.34% after CS, with chorioamnionitis, PROM, blood loss > 1000 ml, emergency CS, and prolonged CS duration being significant risk factors.
gest_age: Mentioned as a risk factor, with <37 weeks increasing the risk of SSI
